text: S671 starts one distinct source-exact hypothesis on the existing Polo M fixture: split only the long straight segment adjacent to each of the five shallow failing CUT corners into collinear steps ≤0.05 cm, preserving the exact represented path and all original source records. CLO Standard import runs once; export only if every native CUT/SEW and semantic gate passes. Stop on a miss; no alternate density/mode or tolerance change.
